Follow Jesus on Instagram: "Chuck Norris has passed away at age 86, leaving behind not just a legacy of strength and success, but a powerful story of faith.

He didn’t start out as the confident figure people know today. He grew up in a broken home, shy and unsure of himself — but his mother kept speaking truth over him: “God has a plan for you.”

That seed of faith stayed with him. He came to know Jesus early on, but later in life, his faith deepened. He rededicated his life to Christ as a young adult, realizing his need for God in a more personal way.

Then came a moment that changed everything.

When his wife Gena went into life-threatening pre-term labor with their twins, Norris found himself completely helpless. Despite all his success, he admitted, “all the money in my bank account couldn’t help me now… There was only one person to whom I could turn.”

In that crisis, his faith became real. Not just something he believed — but someone he depended on.

Through both success and failure, he came to understand grace more deeply. As he said, “We all sin… we all have human frailties,” yet God can bring healing and redemption.

His story isn’t just about fame — it’s about a man learning to trust God fully, especially when everything else fails. 🙏"
